answer: In this EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so a node must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service to retain influence. Freshly spawned sybil identities—even those named pearl, cedar, or thread—begin with negligible eigenvector centrality: without trusted paths and corroborating endorsements, they cannot accumulate enough consensus weight to pass validation. Each new identity must earn trust over time rather than inherit it by multiplying identities.
